newsitem.title: USA: New Brunswick sets 10 pct stock dividend.
newsitem.headline: New Brunswick sets 10 pct stock dividend.

text.p: New Brunswick Scientific Co Inc's board Monday declared a 10 percent stock dividend on the company's outstanding common stock.
The stock dividend is payable on May 15, 1997 to common shareholders of record as of the close of business on April 15, 1997. Fractional shares will be paid in cash.

"The large stock dividend reflects our board's confidence in the stability of the earnings and revenue streams that have permitted us to enhance our core businesses while fully funding our new drug discovery company, DGI BioTechnologies," said Ezra Weisman, president and chief executive officer. "The decision to issue a 10 percent stock dividend is an effort by the board to reward shareholders and improve share availability."
New Brunswick Scientific designs and manufactures a wide variety of research equipment and scientific instruments for the life sciences.
